messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from the 3/15 postmortem: we need definitive owners and timelines for the runbook/playbook edits, plus a short recurring check to detect the eviction pattern earlier. Who can pick this up?
maya: I can own the runbook edits (triage steps + exact commands). Will include concrete checks and a short checklist for drills.
tony-oncall: I'll own the escalation path/roster. There was confusion about infra vs platform paging during the incident. I'll add a simple RACI table and an emergency escalation script.
maya: Planned commands to add: `kubectl top nodes`, `kubectl get pods -A -o wide --field-selector=status.phase!=Running`, and a metrics grep for `kv_cache_evictions_total`. Example: `curl -s $PROMURL/api/v1/query?query=kv_cache_evictions_total`
devops-bot: Created ticket INF-4832: "Postmortem follow-up: runbook + escalation updates" assigned to maya, tony-oncall. Due 2025-04-07.
rachel: I'll review for any customer-facing action and flag if product needs to coordinate comms. Also suggest we add a canary probe to the dedicated pool to surface slow eviction ramps.
tony-oncall: Canary probe snippet I'll add to playbook:
```yaml
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  periodSeconds: 45
  failureThreshold: 3
```
This should trip before we see wide eviction.
maya: ETA: PR with runbook edits by EOD tomorrow. Will include reproducible detection queries and links to dashboards.
tony-oncall: ETA for escalation roster + RACI: within 3 days. Will also publish emergency call tree and add fallback autodial via our pager system.
sam: Great. Action recap: maya -> runbook triage PR by tomorrow; tony-oncall -> escalation matrix + roster in 3 days; rachel -> customer/comms review; devops-bot -> create/track tickets. Schedule a 2-week follow-up to validate changes and watch for recurrence.
rachel: Scheduling recurring 2-week check and will attach a short follow-up checklist to the runbook (verify alerts, canary probe health, run a drill).
sam: Thanks. Once PRs land we'll close INF-4832 and mark the playbook with owners and SLOs for detection.
